content: Mimmigan-ebo nued-nanamalad-igar
Mimmigan, Bab-Jesús-nuggine, nue be-babganba uaya-nikaa be damalo, ar we, igar-nuedid.
Deuteronomio 5:16a Ar we bur igar-sunsogedid. Agi Bab-Dummad anmarga sogsad:

content.text: “Weba be damalale, ibmar-nued an bega ukoye.
degine, adi, we-napneggine bemar sereddii megegar.”

content: Deuteronomio 5:16b
Degine, babgan, bemarmoga, mer binsa be-mimmigan-ourwed be sao. Suli, degisuli. Bur be Bab-Dummad-urbaligwa-nanaedgi be odurdako, degine, Bab-Dummad-igar-nuedgi-unadii be imako.
Maigan, degi, dummagan, igi-damalargebe

Maigan, bemar be-dummagan-we-napnegginmaladgi nue eba be uaya-nikaa damalo, dobekwaa egi be gudimalo. Mer egi be isdaradgi-gudii gumalo, egi-nued-binsaedgi be damalo, Cristoʼga-arbanaiyob be imakmalo.
Be nue arbamar. Mer be be-dummad-be-dakdiidginbi arbamalo, be ega oyogega be nued arbamar-dakleye. Ar bemar Cristo-maiga-gusoggu, Bab-Dummad-sogedba be nue ulubgi ise-arbaar imakmar.
Bemar nue weligwar ulubgi ise-arbaar be imakmar. Bab-Jesúsʼga-arbanaiyob be imakmar, dulemarga arbanaisuliyob be imakmar.
Ar be nue-wismalad, be maiga-gudiidgindibe, maiga-gudiidginsurdibe, gwenna-gwenna be ibmar-nued-imaksadba, Bab-Jesús bemar-bennukoed.

Degine, dummagan, bemarmoga, be mai-nikmalad, bemar be-maigan be nue akwemarmogo, mer be be-mai-sabsur-imakmalo. Nue be insamalo, bemala, degi, be-maigan, dummad-wargwenna nikamalad. We-bemar-Dummadi, nibneggi maid. A-Dule-Dummadi bela emarbi dulemar-dakmaid.
Burbar-urwedgi ibmar-ebulemalad
Emigindi gwenadgan, Bab-Jesúsʼgi gandik be akamar. Cristo-e-ganguedgi gatik be gangumai gumarsun.
Igi sordamar urwenasokalir, urwed-mor yosdamala, deyob Bab-Dummad-e-gangued-burbaled-uked be yomar, adi, nia-saila bemar-yardakarsogele, bemar nia-saila-abin ganna gwisguegar.
Degisoggu, a-ulale, bemar Bab-Dummad-e-gangued-uked-e-mor-burbaled be yomarsun, adi, bemar ibagan-isganagi nabir bela ulusad-sorba amba gandik gwichi guegar.

Degisoggu, be gandik gwisgumar. Nue salakarmar. Ar igi sordamar urwed-idu guakwaa gudiguegala, e-saderba molidub-nasikdamala, deyob be Bab-Dummad-igar-napiragwad-wisidba be guakwaa gudigumar. Mer nailikguega, igi sordamar na binasgargi arsoged yodamala, deyob be igar-innikigwadgi nanamar.
Ar igi sordamar bato naegala, guakwaa sapat-yoi gudidae, deyob be Bab-Gayaburba-Nued-gwage-bogidik-saed-barsogega, be guakwaa gudisamar.
Ar igi sordamar na e-sigu-abgaedgi dukue, deyob be Jesucristoʼgi napiragwadgi-bensuli be nanamar. Adi, sunna bemar sigu-gwabunyearmalad nia-saila-miedi, oginnegar.

Igi sordamar nono-arsogega bormo-gurgin e-nonogi-sii dae, deyobi abonoleged-igargi be nanadii imako. Degine, nia-abinsaega, Bab-Dummad-Burba-e-es-suid be sue. We-es-suid an bega sogedi, Bab-Dummad-e-gayaburba gued.

Bab-Dummad-Burbaba bela-bela be Bab-Dummadse gordii imako. Babse-akar-akar-gorlegedgi, degine, bela ese ibmar-egisedgi be Bab-Dummadse gole. Be guagwar gudii imakmar, degine, bela Jesucristoʼgi-akananaimaladga Bab-Dummadse be gordigu imakmar.

Degine, be anga Bab-Dummadse gormarmogo, adi, Bab-Dummad-Igargi an sunmakdele, Bab-Dummad anga an-ibmar-soged ukegar, degine, an dobsuli e-Gayaburba-dule-sunna-abonoged-epenne-dukuar-maigusadgi an sunmakegar.

Ar ade, Bab-Dummad-nuggi-an-sunmakdiid-ular an esgoro-dubgi emi an edilles mellesisunnad. Anga Bab-Dummadse gatik gormalo, adi, an dobsuli we-Gayaburbagi an sunmakegar. Ar deyob an dobsuli sunmakergebed.
Pablo, we-garda-narmaksiidgi napi ibmar sogsad
Tíquico, anmar-gwenad-sabed, degi, Bab-Jesúsʼga-arbadiid-dule, a-dule, gwen galakudisulid, a bemarga sognadapoed, igi an gudii, degine, ibimar an imaknaibali.
Ar a-ulale, an bemarse Tíquico-barminaid, adi, be wisgumalaga igi anmar gudidii, degine, adi, bemar-gwage-ogannomalagarbar.
Gwenadgan, Bab-Dummad-anmar-babga-gumaid, degi, Bab-Jesucristo, ulubgi bogidik bemar-ito imaksun. Degine, sabgued, degi, egi bensulid, bemarga ukbarsun.
Deginbali, Bab-Dummad bela-anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo-nue-sabmaladgi nued binsasun.
